args.title: Fix password reset email link to point to the correct URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Currently, the password reset email includes a link that points to 'http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…', which is not accessible to users. We need to change this so that the link uses the correct base URL defined by the PUBLIC_URL environment variable.
